lines.en: The cold sea current pushes me along.

lines.zh: 整群一起转，谁都不落后
lines.en: The school turns together, no one lags.
I ride the bright band at the surface.
A blue back hides best in water.
This stretch is cold, I swim briskly.

lines.zh: 前面有鱼群散开，我去看看
lines.en: A school breaks ahead, I go look.

lines.zh: 我们从礁外绕，不进浅湾
lines.en: We round the reef, not the shallow bay.
One tail beat and I shoot ahead.
I keep away from the ice water.

lines.zh: 上千条一起游，水都变了色
lines.en: Thousands swim as one, the water changes color.
I follow the one in front.
Fish from cold water have firmer flesh.
I skirt the net, but not far.
Swim faster, the smell of blood is behind.

lines.zh: 我往湾外游，那里水更凉。
lines.en: I swim out of the bay where the water is colder.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙脊走，藏住半边身。
lines.en: I hug the sand ridge and hide half my body.
Cold water through my gills, best feeling.
I wait for someone to get hurt.
The water is two degrees colder today.
The school scatters and gathers, never far.

lines.zh: 我看见一条鳍在水面划
lines.en: I see a fin cut the surface.
Bone grit sinks, I drift aside.

lines.zh: 蓝背配银腹，水里的规矩
lines.en: Blue back, silver belly, the rule of water.

lines.zh: 我嘴里还有骨粉的味道
lines.en: Bone meal still tastes in my mouth.

lines.zh: 冷水海没有暖流，只能硬熬
lines.en: No warm current here, we simply endure.

lines.zh: 谁在水里乱蹬，我就注意谁
lines.en: Whoever kicks wildly gets my attention.

lines.zh: 我不咬同类，除非它流血
lines.en: I do not bite my own, unless it bleeds.
Too shallow here, one wave muddies it.
I count the gaps in the school.
The shadow under the boat, I remember it.
You stand in water with knees bare.
The water in your bucket is cold.

lines.zh: 你在找鱼，我们也在找你
lines.en: You look for fish, we look for you.
Your hand moves slowly in water.

lines.zh: 我们一千双眼睛看着你
lines.en: A thousand of our eyes watch you.
No wound on you, what a pity.
The lid behind you is not shut.
Do not put your hand in the school.
Your shadow darkens the water.
Your mesh is wide, I slip through.
My scales have been scraped off.
I bit shell and my jaw rang.
The whole school is scattered.
Sand got into my gills.
I am swimming crooked.
Who pulled me out of the school?
My dorsal fin bent, I cannot steer.
That blow landed on the surface.
My blue has gone dim.
I need to sink under the reef.

lines.zh: 你手里那块鱼肉，腥得正好
lines.en: That fish chunk smells right.

lines.zh: 冷海食物少，什么都值得看一眼
lines.en: Cold seas are lean, anything deserves a look.
The crumbs you scatter, I taste first.
Blood or bait, I cannot tell.
The school crowds that way, so do I.
Shake the net once and I come closer.
The slosh in your bucket sounds like food.
This smell makes me unable to stop.
One mouthful and we scatter.
Keep your hand still, fish fear shaking.
You stepped into the middle of the school.
A scale scrapes past your boot.
I hit your leg, water bursts up.
The bucket rim is slick, I struck it.
The net scooped and released me.
You turned and broke the school apart.
I hit the reef, two scales fell.
Do not shove me with the bucket.
The water blurs, I lose my school.
Step back, and the school closes again.
Cold season, we spawn behind the reef.

lines.zh: 伴侣只跟一段，游完就散
lines.en: A partner for one run, then we part.
The blue under her belly is paler.
Side by side, tails beating together.
Eggs scatter in sand, no one tends them.

lines.zh: 群里的位置，我替她留着
lines.en: I keep her place in the school.
She turns left, I turn left.
Do not cast now.
Once a year, only this stretch.
Her scales brush against mine.
I hold this bone grit in my jaw.
Fish skin on the bottom, still edible.
I swallow the scale that fell.

lines.zh: 桶里漂的东西，我叼一下
lines.en: I nip at what floats in your bucket.
Bone cracks, powder remains.
This is not fishy, I leave it.
I hold and spit, only testing.

lines.zh: 群里的抢食，我抢到一块
lines.en: In the scramble I win one piece.
Whatever sinks is ours.
My mouth is full, I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 谁受伤了，味道从那边来
lines.en: Someone is hurt, the smell comes from there.
That small fish's fin is trembling.
Blood spreads and my teeth itch.
The school turned, so did I.
It cannot swim, perfect.
There is a cut on your calf.
That churning patch of water is the target.
Everyone ahead, clear out.
I smell iron in the cold water.
This whole school could feed us long.
We close the circle tighter.

lines.zh: 它往哪躲，那边就有我们
lines.en: Wherever it hides, we are there.
The water is all slapping sounds.
Do not thrash, movement calls fish.
My blue back presses your leg.
We keep no order, only speed.
You climb the reef, we wait.
The blood smell thickens.
The front one bites first, I follow.
The surface begins to churn white.
One bite tears off a fin.
My teeth are small but many.
I clamp down, the school joins.
The water fills with our shadows.
Kick all you like, you cannot shake the school.
This bite lands on your boot.
Bone cracks between my jaws.
We feed in a hurry.
Bite, fall back, next one goes.
The water around us reddens.
Cold water brings a shoal of blue.

lines.zh: 我们从深处上来，一层一层
lines.en: We rise from below, layer by layer.
This sea has us today.

lines.zh: 水面先起细纹，然后是我们
lines.en: Ripples first, then us.
A new school circles three times first.

lines.zh: 我出生在冷水，这里也算
lines.en: I was born in cold water, this counts too.
A thousand arrive, the sea feels crowded.

lines.zh: 你们的水桶准备好了吗
lines.en: Are your buckets ready?
We come out of the reef shadow.
This stretch is ours to patrol now.
How can the surface burn?
I am thrown onto dry sand.

lines.zh: 我嘴里全是水，却吸不到
lines.en: Water fills my mouth and I get no air.
A muffled blast below flips every fish.
A spear shaft cuts through the water.
Blue light clings to me.
Three days of empty cold sea.
Lightning crawls across the surface.
The water is gone, empty below.
